meta.name: Garfield and Friends
meta.description:
This classic follows Garfield, a lazy feline whose only desires in life are lasagna, catnaps and avoiding Mondays. Along with his not-too bright pooch pal, Odie, and gullible owner, Jon, Garfield coughs up a hairball of humor that every human will love.

24/7: Garfield and Friends
Available on: Pluto TV
